reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Low Molecule Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text:
I have dry skin, and this cleanser works really well for me because it doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or even drier than it already is. It is a very lightweight and gentle cleanser, yet it truly cleanses my skin; it also creates plenty of bubbles, which is something I absolutely love. I truly adore the Torriden brand—every single product I’ve tried from them has worked for me one thousand percent.
And when I say I adore it, I mean I adore it because this would already be my third bottle...
reviews.zh: 我係乾性肌，呢支潔面產品對我嚟講真係好好用，因為用完唔會有繃緊感，亦唔會比我本身更加乾。質地非常輕柔又溫和，但係清潔力都夠；而且泡泡好豐富，呢一點我真係超鍾意。我真係好愛 Torriden 呢個品牌——佢哋出嘅每件產品對我都係一萬分有效。我話我愛佢，意思真係愛佢，因為已經係我第三支了……

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Low Molecule Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: My absolute favorite cleanser. Just a small amount goes a long way. Gentle and hydrating and use it as a body wash at least once a week because it makes your skin feel that good. Great for my mature, sensitive, 80’s kid who didn’t believe in sunscreen until they were in their late 40’s skin.
reviews.zh: 呢支係我最愛嘅潔面產品。搽少少已經好襟用。溫和又保濕，我仲會每星期至少用嚟沖涼一次，因為用完皮膚真係好舒服。最適合我呢種熟齡敏感肌、80 後細路到大個都唔信防曬、到四十幾歲先知防曬重要嘅人。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL
reviews.text: I have oily acne-prone skin and this cleanser was the best one I ever used before! It feels super super soft on my skin and cleanses so well! My skin felt very clean after using it! I would definitely recommend it! I think for dry skin it could dry out a bit too much tho!
reviews.zh: 我係油性易爆瘡嘅膚質，呢支潔面係我以前用過最好用嘅一支！搽喺皮膚上感覺超級超級滑，而且清潔力好強！用完之後皮膚感覺好乾淨！我一定會推薦！不過我覺得乾性肌用嘅話可能會覺得有啲太乾！

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL
reviews.text: Лучшая пенка которой я когда либо пользовалась, у меня жирная кожа и для нее эта пенка очень хорошо подошла. Достаточно крохотной горошинки для объемной пены, не приходится упорно взбивать пенку как с другими пенками до этой. PH у нее явно не 5.5 , но достаточно бережная и для нормальной кожи
reviews.zh: 佢係我用過最好嘅潔面泡沫，我係油性肌，呢支泡沫非常啱我。只要一粒細細嘅豌豆份量就可以搓到豐盈嘅泡沫，唔使我好似用其他泡沫咁要死力打泡。佢嘅 PH 明顯唔係 5.5，但都幾溫和，連一般膚質都啱用。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Low Molecule Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: Ok honestly really love this but the packaging MOLDS! I tried it twice to make sure it’s not just one time but it happens each time. The plastic around the edge start smelling so bad. Such a shame because it cleanses well and is very moisturizing but I just can’t get over the packaging being prone to molding.
reviews.zh: 老實講我真係好鍾意呢支，但係個包裝會發霉！我試咗兩次去確認唔係單一事件，次次都會。邊位嘅膠開始有陣臭味。實在太可惜，因為清潔力同保濕度都好好，但我真係接受唔到個包裝咁容易發霉呢一點。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL
reviews.text: This is a powerful facial cleanser. You barely need a pea-size drop to clean your face and neck. If you're expecting your face to feel squeaky clean, this is not the cleanser for you. This will leave your face clean and moisturized. I like the tube because it doesn't clog, and it comes out evenly (no wasteful surprises).
reviews.zh: 呢支係一支強效嘅潔面乳。只需要一粒豌豆咁大嘅份量就清潔到面同頸。如果你期望用完面會有嗰種「嗞嗞」嘅乾淨感，咁呢支就唔啱你喇。佢會幫你洗乾淨塊面同時保持保濕。我鍾意用支裝，因為唔會塞住，又出得平均（唔會突然倒好多出嚟）。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Low Molecule Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: If you are a person who likes to see bubbles when you emulsify the product, this definitely has bubbles. Gentle yet skin feels clean and prepared for next steps in your skin routine. I also have used as a hand wash in my hands as I am over 50 and try to use gentle cleansers on my hands.
reviews.zh: 如果你鍾意乳化嘅時候見到泡泡，呢支肯定有泡泡。溫和但用完皮膚感覺乾淨，可以準備做下一步護膚程序。我仲用嚟洗手，因為我已經 50 幾歲，想洗手都用溫和嘅潔膚產品。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Cleansing Foam 150mL
reviews.text: A foaming cleanser that’s better recommended for oily skin. It has a rich creamy lather, although may feel stripping at times. A small amount goes a long way, doesn’t sting nor irritate my skin. Not really hydrating as it’s marketed but still does the job of cleansing.
reviews.zh: 一支比較推薦油性肌用嘅泡沫潔面。泡泡豐富幼滑，但間中可能會覺得有啲過乾。搽少少已經好襟用，唔會拮唔會刺激到我塊面。雖然話宣傳有保濕，但其實唔算好保濕，不過基本清潔都做到。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
